items.title: Meet Angie, the NCIS ENGAGE bot that empowers women at risk of hereditary breast cancer
items.summary: The National University Cancer Institute, Singapore (NCIS) has partnered Singapore health tech AI startup Bot MD to launch an interactive artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot service on WhatsApp, named “Angie”, as part of the NCIS ENGAGE (ExpandiNG Access to Genetic counsElling) project.

items.title: Morula IVF Jakarta uses Bot MD Care to enhance IVF patient experience and convenience through powering WhatsApp
items.summary: Morula IVF Jakarta Clinic is using Bot MD's AI powered platform that automates WhatsApp reminders to keep patients on track with their injection, medication and follow-up schedule, while powering a WhatsApp patient bot to answer their questions instantly.

items.title: ASHA IVF partners with Bot MD to launch the first A.I. powered WhatsApp IVF patient engagement platform in Indonesia
items.summary: ASHA IVF Clinic is using Bot MD's AI powered patient monitoring platform that is integrated with WhatsApp to help patients keep track of their medication, injections and return visits to the clinic for regular check up.

items.title: Bot MD x DigiHealth.id
items.summary: DigiHealth.id has partnered with Bot MD to launch the DigiHealth.id x Bot MD platform to allow its 17,000 members to instantly search DigiHealth.id specific information (e.g. Guidelines, Webinars) and useful clinical information such as drugs, ICD-10 codes, Indonesian national guidelines and over 500 clinical calculators.

items.title: Bot MD - NCIS ChemoCalc
items.summary: The National University Cancer Institute, Singapore (NCIS) partnered Bot MD to launch a chemotherapy and cancer treatment cost calculator that will assist in the estimation of treatment costs and improve financial counselling for patients in line with Ministry of Health's MediShield Life (MSHL) reimbursement model.

items.title: NKTI x Bot MD Hospital
items.summary: The National Kidney and Transplant Institute (NKTI) announced its partnership with Bot MD to launch the first of its kind A.I. clinical assistant in the Philippines. The Bot MD Hospital platform functions as a "Hospital Super App" which enables NKTI doctors and nurses to instantly search for all the hospital and clinical information they need within a single chat interface.

items.title: Bot MD x Siloam Sriwijaya | Pediatric Vaccinations
items.summary: To enhance patient experience and the quality of care, Siloam Sriwijaya Hospital has partnered Bot MD to introduce an A.I. powered platform that automates vaccination reminders using WhatsApp. Parents with newborns delivered at Siloam Sriwijaya will receive automated WhatsApp reminders from the Hospital, without having to download another app.

items.title: Bot MD x Siloam Hospitals
items.summary: Siloam Hospitals Group signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with A.I. health tech start-up Bot MD to automate and scale patient reported outcome measures across their entire hospital chain. This partnership will help improve the quality of care for Siloam patients through automating the collection of patient outcomes before and after treatment using clinical gold standards for Patient Reported Outcomes Measures (PROMs).

items.title: NKTI and Bot MD launch first A.I. powered Facebook Messenger platform for Kidney Patient Education
items.summary: the National Kidney and Transplant Institute (NKTI) announced its partnership with Bot MD to launch an A.I. powered Facebook Messenger and Viber-based platform for Pre-Kidney Transplant donor and patient education. The platform, called "Bot MD Care" will enable potential Kidney donors and recipients to undergo pre-transplant orientation at their own pace and time, through popular chat platforms without having to download a separate mobile app.

items.title: NKTI and Bot MD launch the First A.I.-powered Viber patient monitoring platform to scale care for Kidney patients in the Philippines
items.summary: The National Kidney and Transplant Institute (NKTI) today announced its partnership with A.I. health technology start-up Bot MD to scale the monitoring and care of its kidney patients across the Philippines with an A.I.-powered Viber-based patient monitoring platform.

items.title: Bot MD raises US$5M Series A for regional expansion of doctor-facing A.I. assistant platform by Monk's Hill Ventures
items.summary: Bot MD raises US$5M Series A for regional expansion of doctor facing A.I. assistant platform by Monk’s Hill Ventures.

items.summary: The National University Cancer Institute, Singapore (NCIS) has partnered Singapore health tech AI startup Bot MD to launch an interactive artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot service on WhatsApp, named “Angie”, as part of the NCIS ENGAGE (ExpandiNG Access to Genetic counsElling) project.

items.title: Bot MD x Granostic
items.summary: Granostic's new clinic in Surabaya will be automating lab test reminders and handling patient queries through WhatsApp by using Bot MD's A.I. powered platform.

items.title: Bot MD - A.I. powered vaccination scheduling and monitoring in Indonesia
items.summary: Bot MD has partnered with leading vaccination clinic chain inHarmony Clinic to help automate their vaccination scheduling and post-vaccination monitoring workflows through an A.I. powered WhatsApp interface to improve convenience and access for their patients.

items.title: Kortex and Bot MD partner to launch first A.I. powered WhatsApp neurosurgical patient monitoring platform
items.summary: Kortex has partnered Bot MD to launch the first A.I. powered neurosurgical monitoring platform in Indonesia that is integrated with WhatsApp.

items.title: Bot MD partners with the Indonesian Medical Association (IDI) to provide instant search to more than 200,000 doctors across Indonesia
items.summary: Bot MD partnered with the Indonesian Medical Association (IDI) to embed its A.I. Assistant on the IDI website, enablingo over 200,000 doctor members to instantly search for association information, IDI services and national guidelines.

items.title: Bot MD - NEMG Clinics
items.summary: Northeast Medical Group (NEMG) has partnered with Bot MD to digitize the scheduling of clinic appointments, vaccinations and teleconsultations for all of their primary-care clinics in Singapore by powering WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and their Website.

items.title: Bot MD introduces automated PROMs by powering WhatsApp at EBPOM Asia 2022
items.summary: Bot MD shares at EBPOM Asia how its A.I. platform for doctors is helping hospitals and clinics automate patient engagement and monitoring by integrating with popular chat apps like WhatsApp and Facebook Messenger to scale the collection of PROMs and PREMs while calculating and trending patient scores in a user-friendly dashboard.

items.title: Parkway launches first A.I. powered Digital Radiology Ordering System
items.summary: Parkway Radiology partners with Bot MD to launch the first A.I. powered Digital Radiology Ordering System to enable hospitals and clinics to instantly schedule radiology exams online
